definitions.title: Model Definitions
definitions.description: A configuration that stores pricing information for an LLM model. Model definitions specify the cost per input and output token, enabling Langfuse to automatically calculate the price of generations based on token usage.

fields.modelNameDescription: The name of the model. This will be used to reference the model in the API. You can track price changes of models by using the same name and match pattern.
fields.matchPatternDescription: Regular expression (Postgres syntax) to match ingested generations (model attribute) to this model definition. For an exact, case-insensitive match to a model name, use the expression: (?i)^(modelname)$
fields.matchPatternTooltip: Regex pattern to match `model` parameter of generations to model pricing
fields.tokenizerDescription: Optionally, Langfuse can tokenize the input and output of a generation if no unit counts are ingested. This is useful for e.g. streamed OpenAI completions. For details on the supported tokenizers, see the docs.
fields.tokenizerTooltip: Tokenizer used for this model to calculate token counts if none are ingested. Pick from list of supported tokenizers.
fields.tokenizerConfigDescription: The config for the tokenizer. Required for openai. See the docs for details.
fields.tokenizerConfigTooltip: Some tokenizers require additional configuration (e.g. openai tiktoken). See docs for details.
fields.startDateTooltip: Date to start pricing model. If not set, model is active unless a more recent version exists.
fields.lastUsedTooltip: Start time of the latest generation using this model
fields.maintainerTooltip: Maintainer of the model. Langfuse managed models can be cloned, user managed models can be edited and deleted. To supersede a Langfuse managed model, set the custom model name to the Langfuse model name.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.pricesDescription: Set prices per usage type for this model. Usage types must exactly match the keys of the ingested usage details.
pricing.pricingTiersDescription: Define pricing rules evaluated in priority order. Tiers are checked from top to bottom until conditions match.
pricing.pricingTierConditionsDescription: This tier is applied when the following conditions are met:
pricing.conditionWarning: Non-default tiers require at least one condition. This tier will fail validation.
pricing.invalidPriceEntries: Invalid price entries. Please check your input format.

testMatch.title: Test Model Match
testMatch.description: Test which model and pricing tier your ingestion data would match against.
testMatch.modelNameDescription: The model name on your generations.
testMatch.noMatchDescription: No model configuration matches "{modelName}" in this project.
testMatch.noMatchSuggestion2: View existing models and their match patterns
testMatch.usageDetailsDescription: Add usage details to test pricing tier matching. Leave empty to match the default tier.

actions.deleteModelConfirmDescription: This action permanently deletes this model definition.
actions.createModelDescription: Create a new model configuration to track generation costs.
actions.modelCreatedDescription: The model '{modelName}' has been successfully created. New generations will use these model prices.
actions.modelUpdatedDescription: The model '{modelName}' has been successfully updated. New generations will use these model prices.
